quotes.text: Record if [Name] is person in whose name this accommodation is owned or rented
You told me that [NumHhldrs] people jointly own or rent the accommodation. Which of you/them has the highest income (from earnings, benefits, pensions and any other sources)?
Enter person number of the eldest (joint householder) from those listed below
Interviewer check – The Household Reference Person (HRP) has been computed as [name]

assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire identifies the Household Reference Person (HRP) through an explicit set of rules: HRPID identifies whether accommodation is owned or rented in the person's name; if jointly owned/rented, HIHNUM determines who has the highest income; if income is equal or missing, JNTELDA/JNTELDB selects the eldest joint householder; and HRPCHECK confirms that the HRP is computed automatically based on these explicit criteria.
